run_clustering_inference_pipeline: run the clustering inference pipeline on input JSONL data using a Ray cluster and fitted models
run_remotely_clustering_task: run a remote Ray task that generates embeddings and predicts cluster labels using HDBSCAN or KMeans
run_kmeans_inference: run KMeans clustering inference on embeddings using a pre-fitted model via the Ray remote task
run_hdbscan_inference: run HDBSCAN clustering inference on embeddings using a pre-fitted model via the Ray remote task
generate_viz_coordinates: generate 2D UMAP visualization coordinates joined with cluster labels for a sample of data points
